rules.statement: A fideicommissum simplex is created when a donor transfers property to a fiduciary with the power of alienation, but the gift-over is to the legal heirs of the fiduciary if the fiduciary does not exercise the power of alienation.
rules.supporting_quote: "The deed of gift created a fideicommissum simplex and that, as the transfer of 1st January 1924 was not a permitted alienation, the legal heirs of the fiduciary would be entitled to the property on the death of the fiduciary."
